title: SDD lab port mapping
description: Canonical kind/K8s port assignments. Generated artifacts (infra/k8s/kind-config.yaml extraPortMappings and infra/k8s/overlays/*/service-patch.yaml nodePorts) are derived from this file by tools/sdd_cli/k8s_ports.py.

registry.description: Image registry prefix used for all app images

appPorts.description: Container port per appId (must match the app's Dockerfile EXPOSE)

hostPort.description: Host port for kind extraPortMappings (direct localhost access). Allocated per role in blocks of 10 anchored at the role base: web from 8081 (8081-8090, then 8091-8100, ...), api from 5002 (5002-5011, then 5012-5021, ...). Must be >= the role base, unique across ALL environments, and must not collide with reserved lab service ports (see RESERVED_HOST_PORTS in tools/sdd_cli/k8s_ports.py: Gitea 3000/2222/8123, Nexus 8088/5001, OpenProject 8080, Grafana 3001, probe 8090, Dozzle 8888, Seq 5341).

nodePort.description: Cluster-scoped K8s NodePort (must be unique across environments). Allocated per env per role in blocks of 10 anchored at env_code*1000 + role_offset: dev web 30080+ / api 30500+, qa web 31080+ / api 31500+, prod web 32080+ / api 32500+. Must stay inside the environment range (dev < 31000, qa < 32000, prod <= 32767).

role.description: App role driving the port-range scheme (web, api, ...). Must be registered in ROLE_HOST_BASES/ROLE_NODE_OFFSETS (tools/sdd_cli/k8s_ports.py) — an unknown or missing role fails load_ports validation.
